## Experience

- Wealthsimple: Incoming Software Engineer Intern (Jan 2027 - Apr 2027).
- TD Bank Group: Software Developer Intern (Jan 2026 - May 2026, Toronto).
- Larus Technologies: Software Developer (Sept 2025 - Sept 2026, contract, Ottawa). Production frontend and UX work for ScenarioGPT, an AI planning platform.
- TAIV (YC W20): Software Engineer, AI Operations Lead (Jan 2025 - Jan 2026, Winnipeg). AI operations, automation, internal tools, and product systems.
- Local Reach: Co-founder (Jan 2024 - Jan 2025, Kingston). Local advertising product for bars and restaurants using Raspberry Pi hardware and computer vision for commercial-break detection. Raised $40K+ non-dilutive funding; acquired by TAIV.

## Projects

- Local Reach: Restaurant and bar TV advertising using TensorFlow logo detection, OpenCV colour variance, Raspberry Pi hardware, and IR control. Partnered with four Kingston venues; acquired by TAIV.
- ScenarioGPT: Production frontend and UX for complex AI planning workflows at Larus Technologies.
- BaoBab: Civic innovation project. 1st place at the Mayor's Innovation Challenge, $5K seed funding; covered by Kingstonist and the Queen's Gazette.
- Fight Labs: Combat-sports training feedback app. Most Marvelous Hack at HackMIT.
- Stumble: AI dating conversation trainer built with React, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs. Best UI/UX Implementation at Hack the Hill II.
- Better: NEAR protocol fitness accountability app. 2nd place in the NEAR category at HawkHacks.
- Dear Journal: Structured journaling experiment. Top 5 at QHacks.
- Cat's Cradle: Unity puzzle game for GMTK Game Jam 2023. Ranked 299th of 6,600+ submissions.
